subs: Circuit switching: dedicated path (telephone); message switching: store-and-forward the whole message; packet switching: data in packets — datagram or virtual circuit
OSI: physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation, application; TCP/IP: network access, internet (IP), transport (TCP/UDP), application
Framing, flow control (stop-and-wait, sliding window), error control (ARQ: stop-and-wait, go-back-N, selective repeat); error detection: parity, CRC, checksum

q.x: The topology in which there are ‘n’ devices and each device has n − 1 ports is (A) star topology (B) bus topology (C) ring topology (D) mesh topology (E) Answer not known
cf: Full mesh: each of n devices needs n − 1 ports.
